q: Which grid emission factor should a Malaysian supplier use?
title: Malaysia grid factor by region
short: Use the official grid emission factor for the region where the power was used and the year it was used. Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak run separate grids. Peninsular power is coal and gas heavy; Sarawak's is mostly hydropower, so its factor is much lower. Never use one national average for all three.
audience: Manufacturers and exporters in Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak answering buyer Scope 2 questions

ul: Location based Scope 2: the published factor for your grid region and year.
Market based Scope 2: renewable energy certificates or a supply contract that meets the Scope 2 Quality Criteria.
Off grid or captive supply: the supplying plant's own rate.

p: Record the publication, its year and the value. Use the same source each year and update when a new figure appears.

senseible: Senseible reads each site's monthly electricity bills into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 2 record. Grid factors outside India are entered from the official source for the country and year, and are labelled with that source.
